headline: England edge it as Max’s double-act dents the field
text: Biggest cheer of the lot goes to England (Alex), nicking Mexico (Rosaria) 3-2. Max had a mixed old afternoon: Norway beat Brazil 2-1, but then France (Carolina) were swept aside 1-0 by Paraguay (Max), so he still came out of it smiling. Rosaria takes the hit, while Carolina also missed out. At the top, Max is still best overall on 29 points. At the other end, Sofia is bottom on 10, looking a bit forlorn.
